players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 7,821,759,100.84, up 2.53%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,186,000,791.50, up 30.17%, but excluding non-recurring items RMB 746,984,454.92, up 2.42% - net non-recurring gains of RMB 439,016,336.58 came mainly from fair-value gains on financial assets held. By business: optical interconnect RMB 38.03 hundred million, intelligent sensing RMB 18.79 hundred million, intelligent manufacturing RMB 19.29 hundred million. Overseas revenue RMB 1,648,254,840.07, up 115.67%, 21.07% of revenue; domestic revenue RMB 6,173,504,260.77, down 10.07%.

2026 half-year report: optoelectronic device products earned RMB 3,802,830,759.38 in H1 2026, up 1.56%, at a 14.47% gross margin (up 3.60 points); the company says AI high-speed optical interconnect revenue grew fast and its 800G and 1.6T transceivers are in global volume delivery with an improving customer structure and a steadily rising delivery share. It completed 3.2T NPO development with a first live showing at OFC, launched a 6.4T NPO solution and a 12.8T XPO sample on a 200G/lane architecture (industry first, company claim); 50G PON OLT samples went to key customers.

2026 half-year report: operating cash flow was RMB -1,197,715,100.42 (H1 2025: RMB -481,439,084.47), which the company attributes to building stock to meet order growth and raw-material supply fluctuation; inventory reached RMB 4,507,868,351.57 (end-2025: RMB 3,581,241,659.54). The next-generation ultra-high-speed optical module R&D center and high-speed optical module production base (budget RMB 485,624,023.26) was 87.20% complete, with RMB 163,977,240.99 in progress; total construction in progress RMB 384,210,794.65.
